headline: DCM Shriram Fine Chemicals accepts resignation of Aditi Dhar
hook: Leadership change at DCM Shriram unit
summary: DCM Shriram Fine Chemicals has officially accepted the resignation of Aditi Dhar. The company confirmed the departure through a regulatory filing. No specific reason for the resignation or details regarding a successor were provided in the announcement.
why_it_matters: Minor management changes typically have limited impact on stock performance.
